basics.name: Ismail Kattakath
basics.label: Principal Software Engineer | Applied AI & Cloud Platforms
basics.summary: Principal engineer for production multi-tenant AI SaaS and applied AI platforms — not demos. Own the backend and cloud for an AEC estimation AI product on AWS Canada Central: Python/FastAPI (Lambda, CDK, Aurora Serverless v2), multi-tenant Cognito security, Stripe free/trial/paid with AI usage metering and overage, Document AI (batch OCR/vision, LiteLLM), and realtime collaboration. Prior GenAI infrastructure including multi-GPU inference (vLLM/Kubernetes; ~25% cost / ~40% latency on that platform), RAG, MCP, multi-agent, Snowflake agents, and vendor-scale image pipelines (80+ apps). Long-run digital health platforms (100k+ users, 99.5% uptime, OAuth/SAML federation, Next.js, AWS). Focus: multi-tenant AI SaaS backbone, AI usage billing, Document AI / production GenAI, and inference economics. 15+ years shipping systems end-to-end.
